scenarios.name: immutable_reference_identity
prove: rename Customer/Contact/Dispatch Location leaves UUID unchanged
all dependent relationships still resolve immutable ID

scenarios.name: duplicate_names_are_valid
prove: two active Contacts may share exact name
two Customer Organizations may share exact normalized name
no uniqueness constraint or silent merge fires

scenarios.name: matching_golden_vectors
prove: NFKC applied
Unicode whitespace runs collapse to one ASCII space
casefold applied
accents preserved
punctuation preserved
Python 3.13 and 3.14 produce accepted identical golden results

scenarios.name: contact_email_scope
prove: same normalized email under different Customer affiliations does not create global collision
same email within requested scope may return multiple candidates and AMBIGUOUS
unbound scope searches only currently unbound Contacts

scenarios.name: matching_is_read_only
prove: UNRESOLVED/UNIQUE_CANDIDATE/AMBIGUOUS queries create no rows/audit/lifecycle events
unique candidate does not itself merge/link

scenarios.name: affiliation_continuity
prove: Contact starts unbound or with one current affiliation
change closes prior row and inserts new current row atomically
contact_id never changes
partial/dual-current state impossible

scenarios.name: historical_org_context_survives
prove: later Contact affiliation change does not rewrite organization-at-use snapshots stored by consuming domains
historical affiliation rows remain queryable

scenarios.name: contact_archive_blockers
prove: registered active requester/assignment dependency blocks archive
all blockers returned deterministically
no lifecycle state/event/audit mutation when blocked

scenarios.name: dispatch_archive_blockers
prove: active Site-dedicated relationship blocks independent archive
unfinished logistics dependency blocks archive
Site/logistics domain state is never silently unlinked

scenarios.name: reactivation
prove: explicit reactivation preserves archived history
new conflict blocks reactivation atomically
active selectors include record only after successful commit

scenarios.name: dispatch_customer_neutrality
prove: dispatch_locations schema has no Customer ownership/preference field
same active location can be used by valid operation roles without changing master identity
operation role remains on consuming operation

scenarios.name: site_dedicated_dispatch_atomicity
prove: LLD-08 coordinator creates site-derived Dispatch Location and one-to-one Site relation in same UoW
failure inserting Site/relation rolls back location
second Site using same dedicated Dispatch Location is rejected by LLD-08 relation constraints

scenarios.name: site_derived_address
prove: site-derived location stores no standalone address
current address is read through SiteDispatchAddressProvider
later Site address change updates current projection but not prior LLD-07 logistics snapshots

scenarios.name: singleton_user_profile_identity
prove: first-run can create one metadata identity
second singleton insert fails
Contact cannot be used as login identity
no verifier/password/key material exists in LLD-02 tables

scenarios.name: settings_read_purity
prove: absent known setting returns DEFAULT with no row creation
unknown key rejected
read produces no audit/receipt/default persistence

scenarios.name: settings_atomic_write_and_upgrade
prove: semantic owner + strict JSON validation occur before write
stale revision blocks write
failed upgrade preserves old value/version
successful write/upgrade commits value+receipt+audit atomically

scenarios.name: settings_secret_exclusion
prove: password/verifier/key/token/device-credential definitions cannot register in ordinary setting store
unsafe JSON never falls back to generic serialization

scenarios.name: reference_lifecycle_append_only
prove: accepted create/archive/reactivate/correction lifecycle events cannot update/delete
required audit references resulting lifecycle identity
audit failure rolls back reference mutation/event

scenarios.name: stale_reference_edit
prove: two editors use same base revision
first commit increments revision
second gets STALE_REVISION and cannot overwrite first

scenarios.name: dependency_validator_ownership
prove: validator registry calls explicit domain validators using same UoW
LLD-02 contains no direct SQL against Tickets/Inventory/Infrastructure/Communications private tables
validator failure rolls back lifecycle command

release_rule: All deterministic scenarios pass under Python 3.13 and 3.14 foundation matrix; test fixtures contain synthetic reference data only.
